purpose: Prove href capture resolves to an ABSOLUTE destination for every anchor shape (relative, root-relative, hash route, scroll anchor, javascript:, external) so the crawler can follow routes directly, and prove an <a> with no href is not a link at all.
targeted_defect: None (regression guard). Pins hrefOf() reading the IDL property rather than the raw attribute - the raw attribute would leave the crawler with 'policy.pdf' and no origin to resolve it against, and every href-follow traversal would dead-end.

href_absoluteness.why: Every captured anchor href except the javascript: scheme must be absolute. A relative href reaches the crawler with no origin to resolve it against and the follow dead-ends.
